name: Terraria EN — curated SFT corpus with validation
attribution: Contributors to Official Terraria Wiki (wiki.gg). Terraria belongs to Re-Logic.
scope: Unmodded Terraria for modern PC versions and ordinary worlds unless stated otherwise. This is a curated teaching corpus, not a complete wiki dump or a homogeneous snapshot of one patch.
method: Synthetic English questions and answers, paraphrased from reviewed Official Terraria Wiki pages and indexed excerpts. No images, audio, dialogue dumps, or large copied passages are included.
system: Answer questions about unmodded Terraria in English. Be accurate, concise, and practical. Distinguish progression requirements, biome requirements, difficulty, and version-specific behavior when relevant. If required context is missing, ask for it instead of inventing facts.
split_policy: Source-level separation. Training, validation, and final evaluation use disjoint wiki articles. Validation may be used for checkpoint selection and hyperparameter development. Final evaluation must not be used repeatedly for tuning.
